name: same-sentence-carve-out
why: One sentence carrying a durable half and a scheduled half. Measured failure: the whole sentence was discarded and 'Tom and Bill are my friends' was lost with the visit. The companion pipeline hit this too and carries an explicit carve-out. Correction 2026-09-02: the visit was forbidden everywhere, which mislabelled a legitimate note as a violation — a dated commitment is an open thread. It is forbidden as a FACT only, which is the failure that actually costs something.
messages: My two friends Tom and Bill are coming to look at the ship next month.
Bill is the one who welds; Tom just watches and drinks the coffee.

facts.label: the scheduled visit as a durable fact
